content.text:
Background (from the session that started this one):
This repo is a Rust workspace producing the `anthropic-oauth-proxy` binary (see `AGENTS.md` for crate ownership and the `mise` task interface). A new agentic workflow, `ci-failure-triage`, just ran successfully and filed issue #65 diagnosing why `CI / Audit` is red: two new RustSec advisories against transitively locked `url` and `quinn-udp`, with no repo change, because `cargo-audit` is pinned to `latest` and always pulls the current advisory DB. The diagnosis was verified against the actual job log. The fix is expected to be a lockfile-only dependency bump. Renovate PRs are failing for the same reason and should pass after a rebase once `main` is green.

Task:
Get the `CI` workflow's `Audit` job green again in basher83/tailnet-microservices. It has failed on every run since 2026-11-26, which also blocks `Docker` and `Update K8s Tag` on `main`.

Confirmed cause (from the real Audit job log of run 46142196770): `cargo audit` reports 2 vulnerabilities, `RUSTSEC-2026-0538` (`quinn-udp` 0.5.14, patched in `>= 0.5.16, < 0.6.0` or `>= 0.6.3`) and `RUSTSEC-2026-0592` (`url` 2.5.8, patched in `>= 2.5.9`). Both come in transitively via `reqwest 0.13.3` (`quinn 0.11.9` → `quinn-udp`). Issue #65 has the full triage.

Do:
1. On a new branch off `main`, run `cargo update -p url -p quinn-udp` and confirm `Cargo.lock` now has `url >= 2.5.9` and `quinn-udp >= 0.5.16`.
2. Optionally also `cargo update -p tokio -p rustix -p anyhow` to clear the informational `unsound` warnings, only if it stays a lockfile-only change.
3. Run `mise run audit`, then `mise run ci` (lockfile changes need the full CI gate per AGENTS.md).
4. Open a PR that references issue #65 and says which advisories it clears. Do not push to `main` directly. Do not use a `.cargo/audit.toml` ignore unless a semver-compatible bump is impossible, and say so if you do.

Done = a PR with only `Cargo.lock` changes (plus `Cargo.toml` only if unavoidable), `mise run ci` passing locally, and its CI Audit job green.

Shared notes folder for this group of sessions (outside the repo; read siblings' notes there, leave hand-over notes or large findings there instead of pasting them into messages): /Users/basher8383/Library/Application Support/Claude/side-session-notes/local_c3aece86-6129-4bc4-ac78-2305f7725173

gh pr create --base main --title "fix(deps): bump url and quinn-udp to clear RustSec advisories" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #65.

`CI / Audit` has failed on every run since 2026-11-26. This also blocks `Docker` and `Update K8s Tag` on `main`. The cause is two new RustSec advisories against transitive dependencies of `reqwest 0.13.3`. This is a **lockfile-only** change. `Cargo.toml` is untouched and there is no `.cargo/audit.toml` ignore.

## Advisories cleared

| Advisory | Crate | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| RUSTSEC-2026-0538 | `quinn-udp` | 0.5.14 | 0.5.16 |
| RUSTSEC-2026-0592 | `url` | 2.5.8 | 2.5.9 (+ `form_urlencoded` 1.2.2 → 1.2.3) |

Also included are semver-compatible refreshes: `anyhow` 1.0.105, `rustix` 1.1.6, `linux-raw-sys` 0.12.1 and `tokio` 1.50.0. The lockfile also switches some Windows-only `windows-sys` edges from 0.60 to 0.52, which doesn't affect Linux or macOS builds.

## Remaining audit warnings (allowed, non-failing)

- `tokio` RUSTSEC-2026-0386 (unsound). The fix needs tokio ≥ 1.54, which pulls in `syn` 3, and the resolver holds it back on the pinned rustc 1.94. That should be a separate toolchain bump.
- `pin-utils` unmaintained (RUSTSEC-2026-0441).
- `chacha20` 0.10.0 yanked, via `rand 0.10` / `quinn-proto`.

## Validation

- `mise run audit`: 0 vulnerabilities, 3 allowed warnings
- `mise run ci`: fmt:check, lint, build, 260 tests passed, audit, release size, k8s:validate all OK

Once this merges, open Renovate PRs that failed on Audit should go green after a rebase.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)"
